comment: Cross-renderer parity fixtures. See qa/cross-renderer-parity-design.md for the design. Each fixture references an item.json under renderer/tests/fixtures/<uuid>/ + a checked-in Rust golden under renderer/tests/golden/<golden>.png. The harness captures the browser side fresh via Playwright + diffs against the golden (which render_tests.sh's GREEN gate keeps in sync with the Rust path). Thresholds start lax; tighten as drift is fixed. Note: image_slide fixture (planned in design doc) deferred to commit 3 -- parity-harness.html's drawCanvas path only renders text_slide shape; image-asset rendering needs a separate browser-side hydrator. Commit-2 first wave is 5 fixtures, not 6.

fixtures.name: parity_text_static
fixtures.purpose: Text-only static slide. Canvas2D vs fontdue text AA + word-wrap parity.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_dots
fixtures.purpose: bg-system.js Canvas2D dots vs Rust pattern shader.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_solid
fixtures.purpose: Solid color fill -- the simplest pattern. Baseline for color exactness.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_gradient
fixtures.purpose: Linear gradient. Canvas createLinearGradient vs Rust shader gradient math.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_halftone
fixtures.purpose: Halftone offset-grid dots. Pattern tile alignment + density-to-radius mapping.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_stripes
fixtures.purpose: Diagonal stripes.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_scanlines
fixtures.purpose: Horizontal scanlines. Density-to-line-width mapping.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_checker
fixtures.purpose: Checkerboard. Tile size + parity alignment.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_grid
fixtures.purpose: Grid lines. Line spacing + thickness from density.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_rings
fixtures.purpose: Concentric rings. Radial gradient/repeating-pattern math.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_rays
fixtures.purpose: Sun rays. Radial sweep with angular density.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_confetti
fixtures.purpose: Confetti scatter. Deterministic per-seed RNG; tests numerical reproducibility of the LCG.

fixtures.name: parity_bg_pattern_bricks
fixtures.purpose: Brick pattern. Per-row offset + tile size from density.

fixtures.name: parity_motion_ticker
fixtures.purpose: Ticker motion @ tick=1.75. Motion-phase math + per-tick frequency tables.

fixtures.name: parity_blend_overlay
fixtures.purpose: Multi-layer with overlay blend. Canvas globalCompositeOperation vs GLES2 blend math.

fixtures.name: parity_motion_compound
fixtures.purpose: 4-layer compound motion (blink+shake+pulse+bounce) at tick 0.5. Different motion mix than parity_motion_ticker; surfaces multi-motion-phase drift.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_fade
fixtures.purpose: Cross-fade midpoint. JS per-pixel (1-t)·A + t·B vs Rust FS_FADE.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_cut
fixtures.purpose: Cut midpoint (t=0.5 picks B). Single-side-sample vs Rust FS_CUT_B.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_wipe
fixtures.purpose: Horizontal wipe midpoint. mask = step(uv.x, t) per-pixel vs Rust FS_WIPE.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_slide
fixtures.purpose: Slide midpoint. seam-based UV translation vs Rust FS_SLIDE. Tests bilinear clamp-to-edge sampling math.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_scroll
fixtures.purpose: Scroll midpoint (vertical). qarl-bug 2026-05-12: direction flipped + tested. Should pin the fix from c8f22d5/732897b.

fixtures.name: parity_transition_pixelate
fixtures.purpose: Pixelate midpoint. wave/blockSize math + mix vs Rust FS_PIXELATE.
